# Every permission the release APK may ask for, as Exodus's scanner reads it from the merged manifest.
# exodus-scan.sh fails a build whose APK asks for anything not listed here, or no longer asks for
# something that is: a permission can't arrive (or leave) unnoticed through a library's manifest.
# Change this list together with the "Permissions" lines on the Privacy screen (AboutScreen.kt),
# which name the ones the user meets.

# Declared by the app (AndroidManifest.xml) and explained on the Privacy screen.
android.permission.INTERNET
android.permission.CAMERA
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC

# Merged in from libraries. All are install-time permissions the user is never asked for.
# androidx.biometric, for Android versions before USE_BIOMETRIC:
android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT
# WorkManager, which runs the daily check and the recall check:
android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
# androidx.core, which protects the app's own unexported receivers with it:
io.cosgriff.glovebox.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION
